The round is a substantial step up from previous raises (see - Mindgard raises further $8m for AI security testing), and comes roughly two years after the company was spun out of Lancaster University with £3m in seed funding (see - Mindgard raises £3m for securing AI models). Mindgard [...] The new funding is earmarked for scaling product, engineering, sales and marketing, with deployment already underway across Fortune 2000 organisations spanning financial services, pharmaceuticals, gaming, digital services, semiconductors and healthcare, according to the company. That breadth is notable at the Series A stage, but Mindgard is entering a market for AI security that is already very crowded.
